details.description: Player 1 queues for matchmaking
Player 2 queues and pairs with Player 1
Both players establish authenticated WebSockets and subscribe
Player 1 receives real-time PLAYER_DISCONNECTED event
Player 2 calls HTTP reconnect within grace period and recovers state
Player 1 receives PLAYER_RECONNECTED event over WebSocket; match continues
Match started between Player 1 and Player 2
Expired reconnect attempt rejected with HTTP 410 MATCH_FORFEITED
Match authoritatively ended in SQLite with remaining player as winner
Player initiates instant single-player bot match in Obsidian Chess
Bot calculates heuristic move within required latency window (500-1500ms)
Bot match conclusion recorded with is_bot=1 schema isolation
Host provisions 3-player lobby on Vortex Arena
Lobby reaches exact 3-player capacity and transitions to full
4th player entry attempt rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict
Host starts match, transitioning group to active status
Free player launch of premium title blocked with HTTP 403 ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED
